files.title: PDF URLs
files.description: Direct links to the PDFs to compress (public URLs, Google Drive/Dropbox direct-download links, S3 presigned URLs…).

level.title: Compression level
level.description: light = max 2400 px, JPEG q82 (print). medium = 1600 px, q70 (email, web). strong = 1100 px, q55 (smallest that still reads well). extreme = 800 px, q40.

maxImageSide.title: Max image side (px)
maxImageSide.description: Overrides the level: longest side of each embedded photo after compression.

password.title: Password
password.description: For password-protected PDFs (same password for every file). The output is saved without a password.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged).
